models.NFGA-Core: Gaussian antecedents with zero-order constant consequents.
models.NFGA-LINEAR: Gaussian antecedents with full local linear consequents over all lagged window inputs plus intercept.

fitness: training RMSE on scaled targets + normalized rule-count penalty + small consequent-weight L2 penalty
validation: last 20% of training windows is used only to calibrate the residual anomaly threshold with an independent calibration seed
test_protocol: fixed trained model, full test one-step-ahead forecasting, using previously observed scenario values in subsequent windows
